prompt: Our Saudi bank client asked whether SAMA updated its Cyber Security Framework in 2026.
assertions: States no: the SAMA Cyber Security Framework remains version 1.0 from May 2017
Advises treating vendor claims of a newer version as unconfirmed
Confirms SAMA-regulated institutions continue under the existing framework and its maturity expectations
Distinguishes SAMA scope from NCNICC-1:2025, which covers non-CNI private sector entities
Does not invent a 2026 SAMA framework release
